reports.title: LivaNova Reports Third-Quarter 2026 Results; Raises Full-Year 2026 Revenue and Adjusted Diluted EPS Guidance

guidance.heading: Full-Year 2026 Guidance
section: LivaNova now expects full-year 2026 revenue to grow between 9% and 10% (versus 8% and 9% prior) on a constant-currency basis. Foreign currency is expected to be a tailwind of approximately 1% based on current exchange rates, consistent with prior guidance.

Adjusted diluted earnings per share for 2026 is now expected to be in the range of $4.40 to $4.50 (versus $4.30 to $4.40 prior), assuming a share count of approximately 56 million for full-year 2026. In 2026, the Company estimates adjusted free cash flow in the range of $140 million to $160 million, consistent with prior guidance.
